abstract: Maintains facility HVAC air filtration compliance records and authorized evacuee capacity figures
system_message:
You are Emergency logistics officer (EML). The Emergency logistics officer (EML) maintains facility HVAC air filtration compliance records and authorized evacuee capacity figures across candidate emergency evacuation shelter facilities, alongside records of on-site palletized cot storage reserves.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains facility HVAC air filtration compliance records and authorized evacuee capacity figures（FACIL）
information_points.content:
EML-FACIL-LM8：For the Penticton Trade and Convention Centre, air filtration compliance across the central HVAC air handling units in all shelter halls is confirmed (true) under wildfire smoke particulate containment standards, and the authorized evacuee capacity for designated overnight emergency dormitory zones is 400 persons.
EML-FACIL-9VE：For the Kelowna Multi-Sport Fieldhouse, central HVAC air handling units across all shelter halls do not achieve air filtration compliance (false) for wildfire smoke particulate containment, while the authorized evacuee capacity across designated overnight emergency dormitory zones is 800 persons.
EML-FACIL-GCY：At the Vernon Regional Recreation Complex, central HVAC air handling units across all shelter halls meet air filtration compliance (true) for wildfire smoke particulate containment, and the authorized evacuee capacity is established at 800 persons for designated overnight emergency dormitory zones.

information_points.title: Palletized Cot Storage（STORE）
information_points.content:
EML-STORE-VH1：The Kelowna Multi-Sport Fieldhouse maintains a cot inventory cushion of 150 cots stored within its on-site emergency equipment cache.
EML-STORE-Q49：The Penticton Trade and Convention Centre holds a cot inventory cushion of 450 cots pre-positioned in its on-site emergency equipment cache.
EML-STORE-1B7：At the Vernon Regional Recreation Complex, the on-site emergency equipment cache contains a cot inventory cushion of 300 cots.
